AddressWithCoordinate.text:
query AddressWithCoordinate(
    $locationId: String!
    $locale: String!
    $sessionToken: String!
    $adapterOverride: String
  ) {
    address(
      id: $locationId
      locale: $locale
      sessionToken: $sessionToken
      adapterOverride: $adapterOverride
    ) {
      address1
      city
      countryCode
      provinceCode
      zip
      latitude
      longitude
    }
  }
